name: Desk Fan
description:
SUGGESTED PRICE 1050 TK! 
Description:
Exquisite Design: Mini Compact lightweight design, the personal fan provides cooling air circulation in wide angle directions and 180 degrees up down cooling air supply.
Three Speed Adjustable: three speed levels can be variable speed designs providing you more choices in different temperature environments, Sleep Wind, Natural Wind, and Prevailing Wind.
USB powered: powered by USB, and with night lights, is suitable for night use.
Multi Mounting Style: desktop fan can be desktop standing, also with back hooks to hang for wall, ceiling, or camping tent, etc.
Wide Use: Table Cooling Fan Perfect for use in the home, car, office, desktop, camping, indoor and outdoor, and travel.
Specification:
Material: ABS
19.6cmx19.8cmx9cm/7.72inchx7.80inchx3.54inch
Package Includes:
1 Desk Fan
1 USB Cable
Type: Cooling Only
Voltage (V): 5V
Power (W): 5w
Timing Function
No Timing
Remote Control Function: No
Origin
Mainland China
Charging mode
Typec-charging
Additional function
Night light, 180°
Built-in battery 1200 mAh
Fan leaf material: ABS
Wind speed gear: 3rd gear
